patches.reason: Current INP2 writer emits INP2_TAG_BOOL but the reader has no BOOL case, so authored boolean fields are silently lost on reload.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when pinned current upstream decodes INP2_TAG_BOOL into a boolean DataNode.

patches.reason: Current INP2 reader peeks ARRAY_END/OBJECT_END but never consumes the terminator, leaving the stream misaligned for following values.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when pinned current upstream consumes and validates ARRAY_END/OBJECT_END after each container.

patches.reason: Serializable aggregates are given DataNode.init instead of an object node, so field writes do not have a valid object backing store.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when pinned current upstream initializes custom-serialized aggregate destinations with DataNode.createObject().

patches.reason: Fixed-dimension numath vectors such as vec2 are aggregate structs but are serialized as arrays; generic deserialization does not restore their data lanes from DataNode arrays.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when pinned current upstream deserializes numath fixed vectors from DataNode arrays without compatibility code.

patches.reason: Parameter registry dispatch requires the serialized type field, but Parameter1D/Parameter2D omit it, so a current-format save cannot reload those parameters reliably.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when pinned current upstream serializes explicit 1d/2d parameter type identifiers itself.
